title: ApiContract
description: Version 1 rooms, Liar's Dice, and Blackjack contracts, plus NEP-413 wallet sessions and paid Liar's Dice rooms on NEAR Testnet. TRASH has no real-world value.

TokenAmount.description: Exact base-unit integer string. Services must also enforce u128 and budget limits.

chips.description: Chips held. Every player starts with 5; a lost challenge pays one chip to the other player in it.

winnerId.description: The single player with the most chips when the match ends, or null on a tie or while playing.

history.description: Public accepted actions only; no private dice or session credentials. Old snapshots may omit this field.

BalanceResponse.description: TRASH in the player's wallet (token) and in their casino balance. Read from the chain.

network.description: sandbox only for a local rehearsal; never mainnet

game.description: Defaults to LIARS_DICE for older clients. The web client selects BLACKJACK by default.

agents.description: Rule-based NPC seats: 1 adds Don Raccoone, 2 also adds Foxy. Defaults to 1.

paid.description: Paid room on NEAR Testnet: every human needs a wallet session; stakes come from casino balances without extra signatures. Liar's Dice uses the fixed buy-in; Blackjack uses betTrash per hand. Defaults to false.

betTrash.description: Paid Blackjack only: TRASH bet per hand (whole TRASH). Defaults to 1.

winnerId.description: The single player with the most chips, or null on a tie.

standings.description: Final chips per seat. A future escrow pays chips × chip value, which always sums to the buy-ins.

agentMode.description: How agents decide: a live LLM, or the labelled offline mock used without an API key.

winnerId.description: ROUND_RESULT: the player who received the loser's chip.

cards.description: Face-up cards only. The hole card is never sent before the dealer reveals it.

BlackjackDealer.description: The house dealer. It has no seat and follows fixed rules.

phase.description: FINISHED only when the shoe has ended; hands continue while IN_PROGRESS.

handPhase.description: SHUFFLING (hand 0) precedes the first deal; RESULT shows the settled hand before the next deal.

nextHandAtEpochMillis.description: 0 unless the next hand is scheduled. In RESULT, 0 means the deal waits for every seated human to send BLACKJACK_NEXT_HAND.

nextHandReady.description: Players who already asked for the next hand (RESULT only).

hand.description: The finished hand shown in RESULT; a vote for an older hand is ignored.

BLACKJACK_NEXT_HAND.description: Ready for the next Blackjack hand. The server deals when every seated human has asked, or when nextHandAtEpochMillis passes.

BlackjackTally.description: Results across the hands of the current shoe. Blackjacks also count as wins.

BlackjackShoe.description: Casino-style shoe. commitment = SHA-256 hex of salt + ':' + comma-separated order (rank+suit), published before the first card. The reveal appears only after the shoe ends. It proves the order did not change during play, not that the shuffle was random.

payload.description: Public table chat. Player text is untrusted: agents read it as data and it never changes their permissions.
Host only: end a running Liar's Dice match; chips become final standings.

NearAccountId.description: NEAR account ID (named or implicit). Shape only; ownership is proven by a NEP-413 session.

SessionToken.description: Server-issued wallet session from POST /api/auth/verify. Never a wallet key.

RoomEconomy.description: Paid room status. The chain is the source of truth; these values come from confirmed final execution outcomes.

network.description: sandbox only for a local rehearsal; never mainnet

AuthNonceResponse.description: NEP-413 challenge. Sign exactly message, recipient, and the 32-byte nonce.
